notes: No More None Names: a customer imported with the name None now shows its company or contact name, or Unnamed Customer.
Needs Winterization Is The One Switch: checked addresses are never Skipped, Include This Address follows it, and unchecked addresses leave Winterization reminders and Forecast counts.
Send To Teammate On Route: send a stop to a teammate from the Route ⋯ menu.

Better On A Computer: Home tiles fill the wide screen, and Route stops have a ⋯ menu and right-click menu (Edit, Delete with Undo, Move To Another Day, Complete, On My Way, Send) plus mouse drag to reorder.
⋯ Menus No Longer Cut Off: the bottom items, like a customer's Winterization, always show and can be tapped.
